name: issue-token-secrets-v1

attributes.m$K8sThreatMatrix: Credential Access::Issue service account token secrets

description: determines which subjects can create, update or patch secrets in privileged namespaces such as kube-system, letting them mint a service account token secret for an admin-equivalent service account and escalate to cluster admin
remediation: Restrict create/update/patch on secrets in kube-system and other privileged namespaces to a small, trusted set of subjects. Where a subject only needs to manage specific secrets, scope the rule with resourceNames, and prefer namespace-scoped Roles in unprivileged namespaces over ClusterRoles.
